sources.snippet: MiniMax H3 is a next-generation multimodal AI platform capable of understanding text, images, audio, and video within a unified workflow. It enables creators to generate cinematic videos, edit existing media, and produce high-quality visual content using natural language instructions and reference materials.

sources.title: MiniMax H3 AI Video Generator: Create Videos with Sound
sources.snippet: Why Creators Choose MiniMax H3 Most AI video tools do one trick. MiniMax H3 is an open, general-purpose multimodal model that understands your whole creative intent — text, images, sound, and video together — and turns it into finished, watchable content. It moves beyond single-task generation toward one model that can create, reference, and edit in the same conversation.
